title: TE-GvA: counterfactual gather-or-act decisions for fault-driven incident response on the Tennessee Eastman process
description:
TE-GvA is a dataset of gather-or-act decisions in fault-driven incident response on the revised Tennessee Eastman process. Each record is a decision point of a simulated incident with the cost of every candidate action, estimated by branched rollouts of the full simulator with common random numbers. For the link-versus-I/O-module ambiguity the dataset also provides belief labels computed from twin episodes. The archive contains the arrays of the natural and stress sets, the code that generates, labels and evaluates them, the datasheet, and the results behind the numbers of the accompanying paper.
